en: I can't figure out how I'm supposed\nto get inside.
Let me tell you, I found this\nplace.\pDon't look so envious, will you?
The door doesn't budge at all.\nCheck it more thoroughly?
{PLAYER} left the door alone.
On closer inspection, there are\nseveral dots on the door…
The door is open.
There appear to be many secrets\nstill unsolved in this world.
Hmm…
I suggest to you that you, too,\ngive a thought to the secrets and\lmysteries of our world once a day.
I'm curious, what compelled you to\ncome here?
It's been so long since I battled,\nmy instincts are off.
There are several ruins on the\nSEVII ISLANDS.\pThe majority of them date back\na long way.
It's been said that there are\nmysterious stones on this island.\pI suspect it has something to do\nwith the ruins here.
Oh, interesting.
Those ruins over there…\pI haven't had any luck in finding\nhow I can get inside.
A battle with you, so high up!
Oh, the heartbreak of losing so\neasily to you!
Experience the joy of climbing!
I'm pretty familiar with the land\naround these parts.
You don't need to be so pushy.\nI'll be happy to tell you.
The door to the ruins…\nIt has these strange patterns\lengraved on the outside.\pI don't know what they mean,\nthough.
